figurative_meaning_bn: পরিপূর্ণ; যেভাবে ছেয়েছে তাতে চলাফেরা করার জায়গা নেই
figurative_meaning_en: Completely full; so covered that there is no space to move around
example_sentences_in_english: The room is chock-full of furniture.
The market is packed with people, no room to move.
note: Refers to a state of complete occupancy, common in rural or household contexts
